Lemon Pie Cookies
By: Anonymous
Published: Saturday, December 5, 2009 - 11:43pm

Ingredients




1 cup flour
1/2 cup butter
1/4 cup powdered sugar
2 eggs, slightly beaten
3 4 tablespoons lemon juice
1/2 teaspoon baking powder
1 cup sugar
2 tablespoons flour
1/4 teaspoon salt

Preparation

1 Blend together 1 cup flour, butter and powdered sugar. Press into bottom of 9 x 9-inch pan. Bake for 15 minutes in 350 degree oven. Cool. Mix together the remaining ingredients and pour over the cooled, partially baked crust. 2 Bake 25 minutes. Sprinkle with powdered sugar while still warm. Cut into bars when cool.
